★Request
After fade in
Display Rulership (Casual Clothes), striking a triumphant winning pose with a smug look

Well, tactical calculations aside, I can't deny it served as a nice change of pace.
After all, time like this is essential for building rapport...

Trainer, today was quite enjoyable.
...So, what are we doing tomorrow?

(The 'alternative close technique' didn't work either...?
Ugh, they just cut right through it without hesitation.)

Ah, see you tomorrow.
............

That is good. It's uncrowded, semi-indoor, and provides
fresh air, so I figured it would be a calming environment.
Huh? Nervous...?
Let's see... Shall we play that rock-paper-scissors game over there?

I had just finished up my errands and was about to catch my breath—
Ah, right, I have just the thing.

—We arrived at a five-star hotel's tea room.
Expertly served black tea, a three-tiered stand... it was the real deal...

When I answered, a look of mild relief crossed her face.
I was surprised by the sudden invitation, but I am free after school tomorrow.

Hm? Very me...?
Wait. Does that mean... then...

(Was there any reason to be? We just had tea at an ordinary café...
...Tch, unavoidable. Time to change strategies!)

Ugh... it's getting chilly.
Let's head inside. Um... is it this way?

Y-You're actually asking that?!
I-I mean, if you really don't want to, it's fine, but...

Hahaha, a completely trivial game of chance isn't bad once in a while.
Hm, apparently it detects what hand you play with motion sensors.

I'll let them see a rare side of me—normally so 'mature'—embracing childlike fun.
It will project approachable charm. Truly killing two birds with one stone.

Ah, hey, are you alright?
Ah... you just spilled it. You didn't burn yourself, did you?
Would you like to come along? Come now, no need to be modest.

Another draw, you say?
Absurd. Probabilistically, that makes no sense.

Ah, geez... Is it evening rush hour?
Damn it...! It's so crowded, I can barely... move...

And that was how I ended up having tea with Rulership.
What a rare occasion...

I'll pass on going out anywhere for a while.
...Though, I wouldn't mind going to the campus cafeteria.

...!
*sigh*... You really are... just unbelievable.

Ah, I'm alright... I've calmed down.
That was a lifesaver... Truly worthy of being my right hand...

Well? Quite a relaxing atmosphere, wouldn't you say?
My family and I have visited here often since I was young.

(You mean I'm just acting the same as usual?!
Wait, where's the gap moe~~?!)
N-Next! We're moving to the next spot!

(Hmm... wait. It may have differed from my predictions, but isn't this board state rather favorable?
...! This can work! With this atmosphere...!)

Even with no particular goal, spending aimless time together felt fulfilling.
...Today, I will ensure you have that exact 'experience'!

It's an invitation ticket to a quaint tea room nearby.
I received it through one of my father's connections, and figured I ought to make use of it.

Rulership gazed at the night cityscape with curiosity.
Perhaps this sort of scenery was unfamiliar to her.

While out taking a walk around town on my day off, I ran into Rulership.
Seeing her out and about was quite rare...!

Magnificent... How beautiful.
Is this truly the same city we were walking through earlier?

Hahaha, reality has insane resolution.
The sheer volume of information doesn't even compare to an overhead map.

Man...
I never would've come to a place like this by myself...

(Ugh, this wasn't supposed to happen...!
We were supposed to have fun and be all 'let's hang out again!'...!)

"—Draw, pyoi! One more tiiime!
Double medals next rooound~~!"

(First, we'll share a meal in a relaxed atmosphere and spark up lively conversation.
Hehehe... The 'luncheon technique' is potent precisely because of its simplicity.)

Ah, Trainer. What a coincidence.
...What's with that look? Even I go outside when necessary.

Trainer... You're already dancing in the palm of my hand.
'Spending time together without any particular business'... That itself is the strategy.

Or would you rather come over to my stronghold to play board games?
I plan to be there all day tomorrow. You can come as soon as you're done with work.

(Going outside is nothing but trouble... but, hmm.
When I'm with them... how should I put it...)

This is... totally... *wheeze*... *pant*—
Sorry, I seriously... caaaan't... do this... anymore...

It seems to predict what I'm playing within fractions of a second based on how wide my hand is opened.
On top of that, it calibrates the overall odds so you narrowly miss winning.

Kyahaha...! To think I'd underestimate a children's game!
However! Once I deduce the mechanism, victory is mine!

...Oh? I see. So that's how it works.
Trainer, this motion camera is remarkably sophisticated.

I'll hit it with a feint!
This ends on the next round! Rock, paper, scissors, pyoi!!

And Rulership secured a glorious victory!
The satisfied expression on her face was truly that of a master of the board.

(What now? I have to turn this around somehow.
Is there any field that gives me the advantage...? Ugh, there are so many people...)

After leaving the tea room, Rulership
mentioned wanting to stop by an arcade.
—There definitely ought to be more of this kind of thing!!

An element of surprise intensely captivates others' interest...
In other words, the next move is 'Operation Gap Moe'!

(Do that, and Trainer will naturally want to make time like this.
...And eventually, it'll become 'routine.' That's the plan.)

(Well, fine. Today's preliminary moves will pay off in the next game state.
For now, consider this an achievement unlocked.)

—Phase One complete.
I successfully guided them in an utterly natural flow.
*inhale*~~~~... *exhale*~~~~...

It seemed Rulership had gotten overwhelmed by the crowd.
I search the map for a quiet place where we can rest.

She started playing with a carefree air.
Just as I was thinking that she could enjoy things like this too...

After that... I walked Rulership back to
the academy dorms, and we parted ways for the day.
—Whoa...! That's so high...
